obstruction_classes.description: A counterfactual payoff/debt atom is not yet a source-matched strategic gain.
A charged tail or retained law is not yet transported through an exact cap/state return.
A static singleton certificate is not yet compiled into an exact chronology.

transitions.summary: Initial mechanically exhaustive antichain: five formal leaves in three obstruction classes.
The exact endpoint-recipient atom interface, arbitrary exact prefix depth, unit deleted survival, and semantic-pair preservation do not imply a source-matched recipient gain.

At the strongest positive-minimum reset-face/law selector, the unique exact cap root may be all-Continue and fix both the semantic pair and terminal law; exact cap-prefix iteration is then the identity.
Changed-state maximal-cap roots form exact punishment-floor prefixes, but their cumulative charge is bounded by the semantic-debt excess and therefore cannot exhaust prefix capacity by iteration.

The current singleton strategic orientation is equivalent to the singleton label alone; its ambient static handoff does not use the packet, and a literal quitting regression permits pure debt transfer with no target observer gain.

Positive punishment, recurrent owner-tail escape, and fixed owner-join loss require no separate compiler: each nondeletion arm yields the existing static atomic-toggle handoff, leaving only its source-matched alignment problem.

A positive gap between fixed-law and global reset-face minima can be carried entirely by a third player's debt, despite retained positive incidence and a strict toggle; it need not fund any reset-owner deviation.

At a unique all-Continue cap plateau, every exact cap-prefix or punishment-prefix operation is the identity with zero charge, complete law preservation, and a compactness moat forcing approximate-root absorption to vanish.

The atomic-or-deletion compression theorem is valid, but its static input is supplied by every counterexample regime independently of the singleton packet. It therefore does not replace, merge, or strategically consume the formal singleton leaf; the earlier representative change is reverted.

After any literal unilateral reset, an arbitrary finite stack of exact cap-Nash prefixes remains fully charged by the reset endpoint's ordinary debt excess. At a minimum-fiber endpoint every row is all-Continue and the semantic pair and complete retained law are unchanged.

Arbitrary approximate cap-changing stacks are charged by the reset endpoint's ordinary debt excess plus their cumulative exact playerwise Nash defect; rowwise epsilon certificates cost card(I) times the summed error. Summable errors cannot create off-budget absorption.

Atom, positive collision, a profitable signed observer edge at the reset target, a commuting reset square, arbitrary exact-prefix depth, complete-law retention, and debt conservation still need not produce any profitable observer deviation at the original source.

Even when all four vertices of a commuting reset square lie on one total-debt fiber, each parallel edge only equates the mover's payoff gain with its debt loss and aggregate opponent debt gain; a positive target edge does not source-match the parallel source edge.

The shared forced-owner atomic barrier does not merge these leaves: the negative-collision barrier is on its actual source row, whereas the observer-absent barrier is counterfactual. Positive forced-row defect, action support, and face loss can coexist with zero gain for both actual-source pure actions and exact endpoint Nash; adding a positive global minimum or terminal gap to this two-player regression would itself assert a counterexample.

A concrete positive global terminal-debt floor no longer requires a uniform finite-horizon cutoff: the semantic carrier is exactly the closure of finite prefix evaluations from the card(I)+2 elementary boundaries, and any inductive finite-dimensional barrier containing those boundaries proves a fixed terminal exploitability gap and nonexistence. The barrier schema is logically complete, but finding a finitely described semialgebraic barrier remains the candidate-specific obligation.

At every exact prescribed-payoff prefix, the source-matched usable part of a strict insertion atom—its incidence times gap, truncated by source debt and net exercise premium—is bounded by the owner's coordinate debt drop and hence by total debt drop. On the positive global minimum fiber it vanishes, with the sharper dichotomy that the atom has zero incidence or is exposed only on a zero-debt owner with zero net premium. The static atom therefore cannot fund a charged exact edge without a new marked face-exit or return producer.

At any near-minimum complete-law reset whose scaled mover gain exceeds the minimum error, the recipient, positive debt slope, and one approximate behavioral response no longer need to be supplied separately. One actual deviation is selected automatically, is exactly affine across source and endpoint, carries the quantitative rectangle charge, and is within 8*M*lambda+eta of the recipient's source debt. The remaining zero-source-debt branch still requires endpoint return or signed source transport.

Any axis-aligned or coordinatewise order-compatible semantic barrier containing the required elementary boundary pairs also contains the diagonal formed by the positive parts of the singleton rewards. That diagonal has zero total semantic debt, so no such independently recombined barrier can certify a strictly positive global debt floor; a successful barrier must couple player coordinates.

The reset-square theorem assumes both the positive target edge and the nonpositive parallel source edge, together with equality of all four total debts, and derives only the opponent-transfer account. It supplies no quitting-game witness where those hypotheses co-realize on a positive global-minimum fiber, so source matching on that fiber is not fenced and remains open.

No positive four-player global-debt certificate can use a barrier whose membership depends only on envelope minus prescribed payoff. Debt saturation supplies a calibrated point on the Never debt fiber, and one rational symmetric product-root prefix multiplies every debt coordinate by its arbitrarily small joint Continue mass, contradicting the floor. Debt-only polyhedral, semialgebraic, and max-plus cylinders are therefore excluded; a successful barrier must retain absolute semantic level.

A literal two-player quitting reset square can have all four vertices on one common positive total-debt fiber while the same observer reset gains one on the target face and loses one on the parallel source face. Thus quitting semantics plus common-fiber equality do not source-match parallel edges. The witness has no positive global semantic-debt minimum, so positive global-minimum provenance is the exact remaining possible repair.
